body:
In #20790 (https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/20790#issuecomment-5373154189) the filename-based fallback for proxies that change file paths was deferred to a follow-up PR. I couldn't find an issue tracking it, so here is one, with JFrog Artifactory as a second registry that needs it (the first was Google Artifact Registry).

Artifactory's PyPI repositories serve files under `<name>/<version>/<file>`, not PyPI's hashed directories. The simple page for `six` already shows it:

```
PyPI:        https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/b7/ce/149a00dd41f10bc29e5921b496af8b574d8413afcd5e30dfa0ed46c2cc5e/six-1.17.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl#sha256=4721f391…
Artifactory: <base>/api/pypi/<repo>/simple/six/ → ../../packages/packages/six/1.17.0/six-1.17.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl#sha256=4721f391…
```

Same sha256. The PyPI-shaped path under the Artifactory base returns 404 (I tried `api/pypi/<repo>/packages/…`, `api/pypi/<repo>/…` and `<repo>/…`), so no `artifact-base-url` makes the prefix swap round-trip:

```toml
[[proxy-index]]
name = "artifactory"
url = "https://<host>/artifactory/api/pypi/<repo>/simple/"
artifact-base-url = "https://<host>/artifactory/api/pypi/<repo>/packages/"  # → packages/six/1.17.0/…, not packages/b7/ce/…
proxy-for = "pypi"
```

I haven't run this against `main` (no release has `proxy-index` yet). From the docs and the GAR report I expect the same result: `uv lock` records upstream URLs that don't exist.

What would make it work for us is an opt-in, per-proxy mode for installs from the lock: look up the locked filename in the proxy's simple index for that package and check the locked hash, instead of swapping prefixes. It costs one index request per package (the GAR report measured about 5 s for a 235-package lock without PEP 658/691), so it should stay off by default. It covers only installs. Locking through such a proxy would still need the upstream URL from somewhere, and I'd be glad to hear whether that half is in scope.

Happy to test a branch against Artifactory.
title: proxy-index: path-independent artifact mapping (Artifactory layout), follow-up to #20790
